description.zh:
采集器类型。可选值：

- fileBeat
- metricBeat
- heartBeat
- auditBeat
description.en:
The type of the collector. Valid values:

- fileBeat
- metricBeat
- heartBeat
- auditBeat.

description.zh:
采集器版本。采集器部署的机器类型不同，可选的版本也不同，具体说明如下：

- ECS：6.8.5_with_community
- ACK：6.8.13_with_community
description.en:
The version of the collector. The available versions vary based on the type of machine on which the collector is deployed. Valid values:

- ECS: 6.8.5_with_community
- ACK: 6.8.13_with_community.

description.zh:
指定采集器部署机器的类型，不填则返回全部。可选值：

- ECS：ECS服务器
- ACK：容器Kubernetes集群
description.en:
The type of machine on which the collector is deployed. If you do not specify this parameter, all types are returned. Valid values:

- ECS: Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance
- ACK: Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster.

title.zh: 获取默认收集器配置列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch list-default-collector-configurations --res-type fileBeat --res-version 6.8.5_with_community --source-type ECS --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun elasticsearch GET /openapi/beats/default-configurations --region cn-hangzhou --resVersion '6.8.5_with_community' --sourceType ECS --resType fileBeat --header "Content-Type=application/json"
